name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ game-global prefix + battle domain (battle render path + AI item-use) + descriptor 'tile_map_anim_frame_counter' accurately reflects the runtime tile-animation frame index/counter and its data type (counter). No Ghidra address residue ('frame'/'counter' are semantic, not hex). Verified by disasm: INC/CMP dword[0x53C1F] wrap at 0x14, used MOVZX as byte index into the 20-entry palette-phase lookup table.
purpose: Battle tile-map animation sub-counter (the 'compose state_b' frame index): a free-running 0..19 cycle used as a byte index into data_fd2_graphics_tile_anim_palette_phase_lookup[20] to select the per-frame tile palette-remap phase.
logic_summary: Three drivers. Free-running mode (data_fd2_graphics_forced_tile_anim_frame == -1): fd2_composite_battle_tile_map increments it by 1 once every 3 BIOS ticks (throttled by data_fd2_battle_tile_anim_last_advance_tick @0x539F4) and wraps 0..19 (resets to 0 at 0x14). Forced mode (forced_tile_anim_frame != -1): copied verbatim from the forced override to pin the phase (shipped binary keeps the sentinel, so this branch is inert). Burst override: fd2_execute_ai_item_use resets it to 0 then steps it 1..8 across composite frames for the long-range item-cast tile-flash. The value indexes the palette-phase lookup to compute palette_remap = tile_anim_table_base + *(int*)(tile_anim_table_base + lookup[counter]*4 + 6), consumed by fd2_composite_battle_tile_map and fd2_blit_animated_tile_at_pos.
element_semantics: Single scalar runtime counter; valid range 0..19 (wraps at 0x14). Drives palette-remap phase selection for animated battle tiles. Accessed as a 32-bit dword (INC/CMP/MOV dword[0x53C1F]) but consumed as a byte index (MOVZX) into a 20-entry lookup table.
notes: Source comment block (rndscene.c lines 32-43) already accurate, precise, and final-state; left unchanged (comment keep). Ghidra plate: the data address had its detailed documentation in the deprecated PRE_COMMENT field while PLATE_COMMENT was empty (null). Per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism, data plates must live in PLATE_COMMENT; migrated the doc into PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline (set_plate_via_java_api) and cleared the stale PRE_COMMENT. Corrected the palette-remap formula notation in the process (old PRE had a garbled 'state_b*4+6' index that conflated the table-base lookup; src comment was already correct). FD2.LE was modified (plate) -- caller should save the Ghidra program. No source-file modification, so the only repo change is this shard.
